crops.micronutrients: Zinc sulphate 33% at 5 kg/acre and boric acid 17% at 2.5 kg/acre at sowing (skip zinc if it was applied to the preceding crop).
crops.source: Punjab Agriculture Department fertiliser recommendations for irrigated wheat, press releases 12 & 18 Nov 2026 (via UrduPoint); N-P-K kg/acre basis from the department's wheat production plan via pakera.pk (checked 15 Nov 2026 against agripunjab.gov.pk).
crops.timing: Apply all phosphorus and potash plus the first nitrogen dose at sowing; split the remaining nitrogen.

crops.standardCase: Punjab paddy, standard recommendation (mid-range of Punjab Agriculture Department N-P-K range)
crops.timing: Apply DAP and potash at transplanting; split urea into 2-3 doses (tillering and panicle initiation).

crops.crossCheck: SBP Indicative Credit Limits 2020 per-acre inputs: urea 100 kg (2 bags), DAP 75 kg (1.5 bags). A commonly quoted extension package is 1 bag DAP at sowing + 2 bags urea split (squaring/flowering); the N-P-K range above is the department's full range and the high end reflects high-yield targets — soil test decides.
crops.source: Punjab Agriculture Department N-P-K ranges (kg/ha) via FSPublishers critical review, Table 1, sourced to agripunjab.gov.pk/croptechnologies; SBP Indicative Credit Limits 2020, Table 2.1; cotton timing via CCRI/FAC cotton guidelines.
crops.standardCase: Punjab cotton, standard recommendation (mid-range of Punjab Agriculture Department N-P-K range)
crops.timing: DAP at sowing; urea split — half at sowing, remainder at squaring (30-35 days) and flowering (55-60 days).

crops.timing: DAP and potash at sowing; urea split into 2-3 doses (sowing, knee-high, tasselling).

crops.source: Punjab Agriculture Department N-P-K ranges (kg/ha) via FSPublishers critical review, Table 1, sourced to agripunjab.gov.pk/croptechnologies; SBP Indicative Credit Limits 2020, Table 2.1.

crops.note: No Punjab Agriculture Department tomato NPK dose could be verified from a primary source in this pass — the app must NOT show a tomato dose. Use a soil test and the district agriculture office's advice.

note: Bag weights are 50 kg. Urea is 46% N; DAP is 18-46-0 (18% N, 46% P2O5); SOP is 50% K2O; MOP is 60% K2O. Wheat bags are quoted directly from the Punjab Agriculture Department November 2026 advisory. Other crops use the Punjab Agriculture Department N-P-K ranges (kg/ha, via the FSPublishers critical review sourced to agripunjab.gov.pk/croptechnologies) converted to kg/acre (divide by 2.471), with bags calculated arithmetically from those ranges — flagged as calculated, not directly quoted. The SBP Indicative Credit Limits 2020 per-acre input table is given as a cross-check. Always get a soil test first; doses differ by soil fertility, variety and previous crop.
